stories.title: SUCH ACHIEVEMENT
stories.body:
Wow, you landed on <blue>THE MOON</blue>!
Set up a <blue>MOON BASE</blue> to begin mining operations.

stories.title: A MAP!
stories.body: You found a <dark>TREASURE MAP</dark>. The map points to a red dot.

stories.title: OCEANS?
stories.body: A <orange>LANDER SHIBE</orange> has returned from scouting <red>MARS</red> and claims to have spotted oceans of <green>ĐOGECOINS</green>. A <red>MARS ROCKET</red> is now available.

stories.title: THE PARTY PLANET
stories.body: You made it to <red>MARS</red>! You see no oceans of <green>ĐOGECOINS</green>, but the vibe is great. A <red>MARS BASE</red> could get the <orange>PARTY SHIBES</orange> started.

stories.title: THATS ODD
stories.body: You found a <dark>CRUDE DRAWING</dark>. It doesn't look like anything to you.

stories.title: GOOD VIBRATIONS
stories.body: The booming vibrations of the <dark>SPACE BASS</dark> have scattered the outer clouds of <jupiter>JUPITER</jupiter> to reveal massive subclouds of <green>ĐOGECOINS</green>.

stories.title: THE BIGGEST YET
stories.body: Top scientists have designed a rocket powerful enough to get to <jupiter>JUPITER</jupiter>. The <orangered>JUPITER ROCKET</orangered> costs <orange>50 MILLION</orange> <green>ĐOGECOINS</green>.

stories.title: CLOUD MINER
stories.body: The clouds of <jupiter>JUPITER</jupiter> are a natural formation of gas-like <green>ĐOGECOINS</green>. Mining the clouds might be easier than mining solid matter!
